meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 启用后,NanoClaw 从 .env 读取 Anthropic 凭据并注入容器,Claude Agent 用它连接 API;不再走 OneCLI 网关。
howto.when: 启动容器时,仅当 .env 设置了 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 且有 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY、CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN 等凭据,才注入;否则不生效。

say.text: 帮我运行 claude setup-token,把新令牌写进 .env。

howto.what_en: When enabled, NanoClaw reads Anthropic credentials from .env and injects them into the container; the Claude agent uses them to reach the API instead of the OneCLI gateway.
howto.when_en: At container startup, only if .env has NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true and a credential like ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; otherwise it does nothing.

say_en.text: Switch NanoClaw to read Anthropic credentials from .env, not OneCLI.
say_en.note: Applies the skill and edits the relevant code.

say_en.text: Set NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true in .env and add my API key.
Run claude setup-token and put the new token into .env.
